_about: Voice-over for the intro video. start = second in the video. Voices are Microsoft neural voices (free, via edge-tts): Neerja for Veri and the narrator, Valluvar for Sandeep, Madhur for Uday, Prabhat for Abdullah Rizwan. Speech bubbles in intro.html use the same times.

lines.text: Hi! I'm Veri, your fact-check guide.
During elections, fake news spreads in seconds.
Step one. Send it to ElectionVerify.
In about a minute, I check the source, pull out the claims, and search fact-checkers and trusted news.
The AI suggests a verdict, and cites every source. But it never decides.
Step two. A human reviewer makes the call.
I check the evidence, then publish.
Step three. A verified answer for everyone.
Now I know the truth. Sharing it!
Built on trusted sources like the Election Commission.
I manage reviewers and trusted sources.
ElectionVerify. Check before you forward. Try it now!
